description: This file contains the implementation of InvokableObjectManager class which manages remote procedure call invocations on local objects, dispatches messages to registered objects, and maintains object lifecycle within the Orleans framework. It also includes internal classes for handling individual object data and message processing.

classes.name: InvokableObjectManager
classes.description: Manages registration, deregistration, and message dispatching for objects that can be invoked remotely. Ensures thread-safe handling of object lifecycle and message processing, and integrates with Orleans runtime components.

classes.name: InvokableObjectManager.LocalObjectData
classes.description: Represents local object information bound to a specific observer ID, including message queue management, message pump processing, and object lifecycle controls within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: TryRegister
methods.description: Attempts to register a new object with an associated observer ID, adding it to the local objects dictionary.

methods.name: TryDeregister
methods.description: Attempts to remove the object associated with a given observer ID from the local objects collection.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a message to the appropriate local object based on the target observer ID.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, cancelling and disposing of the internal CancellationTokenSource.
